title: BridgeErrorObject
description: CONTRACTS §5.3 error detail embedded in a BridgeResponse (status=error) and reused for job failure hints. Carries a §8 registry code; NEVER credentials or raw sensitive values (SECURITY §5). `code` is an open uppercase identifier so the registry stays extensible (§8) rather than a hard enum.

code.description: A CONTRACTS §8 registry code (e.g. BRIDGE_REQUEST_INVALID, DATASET_READ_FAILED).

message.description: Human-readable, non-echoing; must not contain stack traces or raw input (SECURITY §3).

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same command may succeed; mirrors the §8 Retryable column.
